faqs.question: How long does it take to see results?
faqs.answer: Results depend entirely on the therapy. IV Therapy yields immediate improvements in hydration and energy. faqs.question: Are peptide therapies safe and how are they administered?
faqs.answer: Yes, peptides are extremely well-tolerated because they are naturally occurring compounds within your body. We exclusively prescribe rigorously tested, pharmacy-grade peptides. Most are administered via a virtually painless subcutaneous injection using a micro-needle, though some protocols use topical or oral alternatives.
